# HK Open Data

> A bilingual, evidence-labelled catalogue and optional self-hosted toolkit for Hong Kong public-data sources.

HK Open Data is an independent community project. It is not a Hong Kong Government service and it
does not host or resell provider datasets. Catalogue inclusion and technical reachability do not
grant permission for commercial use, caching, scraping, or redistribution. Check each provider's
current terms and applicable law.

## Primary resources

- [Live catalogue](https://angusf777.github.io/hk-open-data/): Search 521 source records.
- [Provider files and endpoints](https://angusf777.github.io/hk-open-data/provider-resources/): Browse DATA.GOV.HK metadata with bounded payload evidence.
- [Catalogue JSON](https://angusf777.github.io/hk-open-data/catalogue.json): Generated public catalogue.
- [Metadata downloads](https://angusf777.github.io/hk-open-data/downloads/README.txt): JSON, CSV, and SQLite snapshots; no provider dataset payloads.
- [DCAT metadata](https://angusf777.github.io/hk-open-data/dcat.jsonld): Machine-readable catalogue description.
- [Self-hosted runtime OpenAPI](https://angusf777.github.io/hk-open-data/contracts/openapi.json): Contract for the optional local runtime, not a hosted public API.
- [Source access guide](https://github.com/angusf777/hk-open-data/blob/main/docs/getting-started/access-recipes.md): CLI, SDK, API, and MCP usage.
- [Quickstarts](https://github.com/angusf777/hk-open-data/tree/main/docs/quickstarts): Evidence-backed examples for representative live sources.
- [Rights guidance](https://github.com/angusf777/hk-open-data/blob/main/docs/governance/SOURCE_RIGHTS.md): Required source-specific terms checks.
